en.headline: Symphony of Lights stages final show on 18 November after 22 years
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board said the nightly Victoria Harbour light and music show will perform for the last time on 18 November with added pyrotechnic elements before seasonal displays take over.
body: A Symphony of Lights, the free multimedia show that has illuminated Victoria Harbour every evening since 2004, will stage its final performance on 18 November, the Hong Kong Tourism Board said.

Board chairman Peter Lam said the farewell show would include added pyrotechnic elements to mark the end of the 22-year run. The board said other light and projection shows would be rolled out gradually next year, replacing the nightly harbour spectacle with seasonal light festivals at different locations.

The show has run at 8 pm for about 10 minutes, involving buildings along the harbour. Popular viewing points have included the Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront outside the Hong Kong Cultural Centre, the Avenue of Stars and the Golden Bauhinia Square promenade in Wan Chai. The final performance coincides with the start of Hong Kong WinterFest.

zh.headline: 幻彩詠香江22年後11月18日最後匯演
zh.dek: 香港旅遊發展局表示，每晚維港燈光音樂匯演將於11月18日舉行最後一場，並加入煙火元素，之後改以季節性光影活動取代。
body: 「幻彩詠香江」自2004年起每晚照亮維多利亞港，香港旅遊發展局表示將於11月18日舉行最後一場匯演。
旅發局主席林建岳表示，告別場次會加入煙火元素，標誌這項22年的匯演結束。局方表示明年會逐步推出其他光影及投影項目，以不同地點的季節性燈光節取代每晚的維港匯演。
匯演每晚8時舉行，約10分鐘，涉及維港兩岸多幢大廈。常見觀賞地點包括香港文化中心外的尖沙咀海旁、星光大道及灣仔金紫荊廣場海濱。最後一場與香港冬季節開幕同日舉行。
